title: CaptchaNo Captcha Solver input
description: Paste your CaptchaNo API key, then either list tasks in Tasks (batch) or fill in the single-task fields below. Get a key at captchano.com.

apiKey.title: CaptchaNo API key
apiKey.description: Your CaptchaNo API key (starts with cn-). Stored encrypted by Apify and never written to logs or the dataset.

tasks.title: Tasks (batch)
tasks.description: Array of task objects, solved in parallel. Each task takes the same fields as POST /v1/solve: type (recaptcha_v2 | recaptcha_v3 | recaptcha_enterprise | turnstile | datadome | image), url, sitekey, action, minScore, invisible, cData, pageData, challengeUrl, body (base64 image), userAgent, proxy. Leave empty to use the single-task fields below.

type.sectionCaption: Single task (used when Tasks is empty)
type.sectionDescription: Convenience fields for solving one captcha without writing JSON.
type.title: Captcha type
type.description: The kind of captcha to solve.

url.title: Page URL
url.description: URL of the page that shows the captcha. Required for every type except image.

sitekey.title: Site key
sitekey.description: The captcha site key found in the page source (reCAPTCHA / Turnstile).

action.title: Action
action.description: reCAPTCHA v3 / Enterprise or Turnstile action name, if the page uses one.

invisible.title: Invisible reCAPTCHA
invisible.description: Set when the reCAPTCHA v2 widget is invisible.

challengeUrl.title: DataDome challenge URL
challengeUrl.description: The DataDome challenge (captcha-delivery) URL. Required for DataDome.

proxy.title: Proxy
proxy.description: Proxy as http://user:pass@host:port (http, socks4 or socks5). Required for DataDome. Credentials are masked in logs and output.

userAgent.title: User agent
userAgent.description: Browser user agent to bind the solution to (optional).

waitSeconds.title: Wait per request (seconds)
waitSeconds.description: How long each solve request may block waiting for the answer (?wait=, max 120). Tasks still solving afterwards are polled every 5 s for up to 180 s.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: How many tasks to solve in parallel.

maxSpendUsd.title: Budget cap (USD)
maxSpendUsd.description: Optional. Stop submitting new tasks once the CaptchaNo cost of this run reaches this amount. Tasks already in progress still finish. Failed solves are never billed.
